status: Integration contract; user-approved behavior with initial tunings pending playtest

approved_direction.range: Reach the current viewport edge along the stream direction
approved_direction.hud: Option A approved by Sean: attached side module with square current-weapon icon and two special-use indicators; preserve existing pictorial health/lives.

input.trigger: Fresh press only; one accepted activation spends one use
blocked_states: scripted flush/ride or camera-test control modes without ordinary weapon combat
input.gamepad_b_context: Dialogue/menu B behavior stays; release before gameplay special can activate
input.empty: No action or spend; optional short feedback only on fresh press
input.unsupported_mode: Reject activation without spending; retain logical-level budget for supported combat.

lifecycle.budget: Two shared remaining uses for the selected hero in one logical level; not per weapon or per section
reset_on: first entry to a new logical level
lifecycle.direct_playtest: Initialize two uses for the launched level
lifecycle.pause: Freeze timeline, movement and damage cadence; pause audio
lifecycle.death_or_teardown: Cancel effect and stop audio; spent use stays spent
lifecycle.nonlethal_damage: Normal damage applies; does not cancel the special
lifecycle.mapping_status: Agreed with Engineering; first-call covers base, trials and integrated bosses; level-two begins at integrated begin_level_two or direct flush/ride initialization.

initial_tuning.status: Mechanics-selected initial values. Tony updated for requested 3–4x active regular sustained DPS; Sean unchanged.
initial_tuning.boss_budget_key: Stable encounter identity across phase/form changes
initial_tuning.boss_rules: Respect existing invulnerability, weak-point and phase transition gates; cap counts actual applied damage
initial_tuning.enemy_rules: At most one tick per enemy per interval across all stream pieces; no frame-rate or multi-segment multiplication
initial_tuning.default_damage_scope: Sean Main Break only; Tony uses the explicit per-hero override below.

tony.comparison: Current First Call profile, not legacy canonical 6 damage / 0.15 seconds. Assumes continuous overlap and an eligible target.

geometry.damage: Only actual visible water envelope can damage; no global screen damage
geometry.reach: Ray extends from registered outlet to current viewport boundary in aimed direction
geometry.occlusion: Clip visible stream and damage against actual projectile-blocking solid geometry; scenery decoration does not block
geometry.thickness: Use full stream width for occlusion and hit tests; no damaging unseen strips past a wall
geometry.world_anchors: Pipe and outlet remain world-anchored through camera scroll; no camera-driven teleport
geometry.fade: Visible shrinking water and damaging envelope shrink together

tony.name: Hydrojet Overdrive
tony.aim: Use existing valid regular weapon aiming and facing, including airborne restrictions; continuous stream through reversal
tony.movement: Normal jump allowed. Idle slides horizontally opposite aim by recoil speed times absolute horizontal aim component. Walking against horizontal recoil gives exactly half normal walking speed net. Pure vertical aiming produces no horizontal recoil. Ordinary terrain and pit collision remain active.
tony.audio: Start once, uninterrupted sustained loop through aim/facing changes, then shutdown
tony.activation: One fresh special-button press starts automatic sustained damage for the action. Neither special nor ordinary fire needs to remain held.

sean.name: Main Break
sean.activation: Requires supported ground and room for the Art-registered pipe assembly; rejected activation does not consume charge
sean.movement: Root during first second; then normal movement while pipe continues independently at original position
sean.facing: Lock sweep direction at accepted activation
sean.water: Three-foot main with full-bore ceiling-reaching eruption; rotate outlet and water together toward facing horizontal, maintaining heavy flow until sputter
sean.art: Use approved v3 direction, physically connected base and outlet; no cup blocking emitted water

spent_pipe.presentation: Retain the bent main at its original world anchor as inert scenery behind the hero after the special expires.
spent_pipe.gameplay: No collision, support, damage, water or continuing special audio. Never count as a platform or change navigation.
spent_pipe.interruption: On death or cancellation, freeze the last actually rendered pipe pose at its supported anchor; do not create a pipe if none has emerged. Stop water and special audio immediately.
spent_pipe.lifetime: Clear at level teardown or scene reset; scene cleanup does not refund spent charges.
spent_pipe.limit: At most two retained pipes per logical level, matching its two-use budget.
spent_pipe.visual_review: Keep ground contact and scenery occlusion correct; verify the spent prop does not obscure floor hazards, hero feet or active enemies.

acceptance: Both heroes: two accepted activations, third rejected; held input never double-spends
B dialogue skip cannot leak into special; K and B work from gameplay
Death/checkpoint/retry preserve remaining budget; genuine new level/new run initializes two
Pause and teardown correctly control effect/audio lifecycle
Tony idle slide, half-speed counterwalk, aim reversal and jump stay collision-safe
Sean unsupported activation rejected, stable world anchor, ceiling-to-horizontal sweep and sputter match visible water
Visible-envelope-only damage and solid occlusion; stable results at30/60/120Hz
Boss damage cap survives form changes and respects closed weak points
Current weapon icon and2/1/0 indicators preserve selected-hero HP/lives and approved themes
Art reviews captured actual motion, contact, jet scale and crowded boss framing; Audio checks sustained loops and mix

Tony: release special and ordinary fire after activation; visible water keeps damaging at 24 per 0.1 seconds (240 sustained DPS) at 30/60/120Hz. Sean stays 12 per 0.2 seconds. Boss cap remains 250 actual damage per activation across forms.

runtime_interface.host_damage_callback: special_damage(segments, amount, activation_id, boss_remaining) -> Dictionary; reports actual boss damage
runtime_interface.tuning_source: Generated data/combat.json; canonical weapon metadata carries special settings. This design contract is documentation and is not required in the exported package.
